summary: Global threat level: High. SAGE expects about 19 countries to see deadly fighting in November and about 2 to be at full-scale war, more than in 93% of months since 1989.
Most likely to see full-scale war in November: Ukraine (96%), Yemen (67%).
Among countries below the fighting mark last month, the highest chance of deadly fighting in November: Burkina Faso (67%), Colombia (46%), Cameroon (30%).
Most tense between countries not already fighting: Saudi Arabia–Yemen, Germany–Russia, Iran–Saudi Arabia, United Kingdom–Israel.
Highest chance of new clashes between countries in the next six months: Israel–Yemen (11%).

Tension with Saudi Arabia is very high; deadly clashes between their forces in the next six months are extremely unlikely (under 1%). Tension with Djibouti is above usual; deadly clashes between their forces in the next six months are extremely unlikely (under 1%). Warning: news of other countries' forces massing against it has been far above usual since 14 October (up to about 4 times).
